_comment: Per-entity config for scripts/extract-votes.mjs. Each entity has a rosters[] array with date-ranged member lists (end:null means current). The id strings MUST match the IDs used in v2/vote-tracker.html *_ALL_MEMBERS arrays.

tomv.label: Mountain Village Town Council

rosters._note: Prohaska Mayor, Pearson Mayor Pro Tem; Gilbride seat replaced by Arguelles at Jul 17 2025 sworn-in.
Prohaska resigned late Jan 2026; Pearson became Mayor, Magid Mayor Pro Tem. 6 voting members until Jansen appointed.
Jansen appointed Feb 19, 2026 to fill vacancy.

tomv._insertionNotes: Entries are inserted in date order. The script finds the chronologically-next /* ── DATE ── */ block after the target date and inserts BEFORE it. Caller is expected to verify.

drb.label: Mountain Village Design Review Board

rosters._note: Pre-reappointment 2024 roster: Liz Caton held the seat later taken by Newton. Confirmed across Jan 4 / Feb 1 / Mar 7 / Apr 4 minutes.
9-member board. Reappointment terms started Apr 25 2024. Newton replaced Caton (confirmed at May 2, 2024 meeting). Roster confirmed stable across Jan 8 / Feb 5 / Mar 5 / Apr 2 2026 meetings.

drb._insertionNotes: DRB entries inserted between TOMV and BOCC sections; entity-scoped insertion in insert-votes.mjs handles the rest.

bocc.label: San Miguel County Board of County Commissioners

rosters._note: Standard 3-commissioner board. Adjust if a seat changed mid-term.

bocc._warning: Roster is a placeholder — verify against the actual *_ALL_MEMBERS array in vote-tracker.html before relying on it for backfill.

pc.label: San Miguel County Planning Commission
pc._warning: Roster intentionally empty — fill from v2/vote-tracker.html PC_*_ALL_MEMBERS before using.

telluride.label: Telluride Town Council

rosters._note: COUNCIL_2024 / COUNCIL_2025_EARLY in v2/vote-tracker.html. Errico Mayor, Fee Mayor Pro Tem.

COUNCIL_2025_LATE: Permakoff (Nov 2025) and Stark (Dec 2025) replaced Arguelles and Shaunette. Boundary dates are APPROXIMATE (from the page's era labels, not sworn-in minutes) — verify against minutes before backfilling a meeting within a week of a boundary.

Fee resigned Jan 2026; Levin became Mayor Pro Tem. The page's COUNCIL_2026 era array still lists fee so early-Jan votes render — for NEW extractions Fee is out (per standing editorial rule she is omitted going forward). Verify the exact resignation-effective date before backfilling Jan 2026. Window closed 2026-07-20: seat filled by Dalton on 2026-07-21.

Charles Dalton sworn in 2026-07-21 after winning the Jun 30 2026 special election, filling the seat Meehan Fee vacated in Jan 2026. Marya Stark won the same election but was already seated (Dec 2025), so she is unchanged. Sources: Telluride Times 2026-07-22 'New council members sworn in'; KOTO newscast 2026-07-13.

telluride._note: Vote items live in the un-prefixed VOTE_ITEMS array in v2/vote-tracker.html with ids like 'v2024-01' (idPrefix 'v' + year + sequence). Minutes: telluride-co.civicweb.net /document/<ID>.

rico.label: Town of Rico Board of Trustees

rosters._note: EARLY roster, through the Nov 19 2025 pre-swearing-in vote. Mayor Fallon, Mayor Pro Tem Hibbard. Condon resigned eff. Oct 16 2025 (often absent before that); Dillsworth frequently absent. Tag those votes era:'EARLY'.
LATE roster. Clark & Anderson sworn in Nov 19 2025 (replacing Dillsworth & Condon). Tag 2025 votes era:'LATE', 2026 votes era:'2026'.

rico._note: Rico meets the 3rd Wednesday monthly at 7 PM. Minutes are PDFs linked from https://townofrico.colorado.gov/government/board-of-trustees with clean roll-call votes. IMPORTANT: each RICO_VOTE_ITEMS entry must carry an `era` field ('EARLY'|'LATE'|'2026') — renderRicoHeatmap() filters by era, not date, because the Nov 19 2025 meeting spans the board turnover.
